posts.content: Jellyfish: An end-to-end production workspace for AI-generated short dramas. From script input to structured storyboarding, consistency management, shot preparation, video generation, and export.

ai.title: Jellyfish: End-to-end workspace for AI-generated short drama production
ai.workflow_stage: concept / ideation | layout / composition | rendering / export
ai.summary: Complete production workspace handling the full pipeline from script input through structured storyboarding, character consistency management, shot preparation, to final video generation and export. Designed specifically for AI-generated short drama format.
ai.why_important: Solves the critical shot-to-shot consistency and structured workflow problems that plague AI video production for narrative content.
ai.learnings: Structured storyboarding and consistency management systems can bridge the gap between script and coherent AI-generated video sequences.

posts.content: LichtFeld-Studio: Train, inspect, edit, automate, and export 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from a single native application.

ai.title: LichtFeld-Studio: Native app for training, editing & exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting
ai.summary: Native application that consolidates the entire 3DGS workflow into a single tool. Handles training, inspection, editing, automation, and export of 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes without switching between multiple tools.
ai.why_important: Addresses the fragmented toolchain problem in 3DGS workflows by providing an all-in-one native solution for production use.
ai.learnings: Single native app can replace multi-tool 3DGS pipelines, potentially streamlining production workflows from capture to export.

posts.content: StableGen: Transform your 3D texturing workflow with the power of generative AI, directly within Blender!

ai.title: StableGen: Generative AI texturing directly in Blender workflow
ai.summary: Blender plugin integrating generative AI directly into 3D texturing workflow. Eliminates context-switching by keeping AI texture generation native within Blender's interface.
ai.why_important: Reduces friction in 3D texturing by eliminating the export-generate-reimport cycle that breaks creative flow.
ai.learnings: Native integration of generative AI into existing 3D tools maintains workflow continuity better than external generation pipelines.
